question: can a delivery intent re-read the digest it names?
the_measurement: 71 delivery intents, all 71 naming a digest, and zero of those digests stored anywhere
what_already_worked: build_digest_id has been deterministic with no clock in it since Gate 142, so a records table could use it as a real key rather than inventing a surrogate
why_it_mattered: a tenant misses a deadline and asks what NativeForge told them. The intent could say a digest was queued with four items visible and two suppressed; the digest could say nothing, because it did not exist. For a product whose purpose is award compliance, that is the wrong half of the record to have kept.
